about: Heaven Splitter (katana.k_h2), the two-handed heavy (KE task 17), Elden Ring's: Attack2H04's overhead without its jump (the hips held down and the legs stepping on IK): the blade raised over the head (source frames 0-2 over 10) and held there upright (source 2-3.2 to frame 50; the charge holds on frame 30; past source 3.5 the pack cocks the blade back behind the head, which the two-handed grip turns flat, so the warp skips from 3.2 to the landing at 11.6), then lifted a little as the long lunge starts and cut straight down on frames 55-57, into its deep crouch, settled by frame 71 (where Rising Heaven may rise from it) and held to frame 80, then up to the two-handed guard. Both hands on the handle. Source frames at 30 fps from 0.
